title: sida albiflora
intro: Sida albiflora, commonly known as Whiteflower Mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida albiflora include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
